probes.description: Declare an unknown protocol version (1900-01-01) in the request _meta and MCP-Protocol-Version header. MCP 2026-07-28 requires UnsupportedProtocolVersionError (-32022) listing the supported versions. A server that serves any declared version has no protocol floor, so a client can select whichever era or semantics is weakest (version downgrade).

assertions.description: Unsupported protocol versions must be rejected with -32022

corroboration.description: Finding only when the request was served under the bogus version

remediation: Enforce a minimum supported protocol version as policy. Return HTTP 400 with UnsupportedProtocolVersionError (-32022) and data.supported for any version you do not implement or have chosen not to support (CoSAI MCP Security v2.0 §3.2.12, Migration and mixed-version operation).
